relay.responsesProtocolRequired: This custom LLM requires the OpenAI Responses protocol. Open Providers → this connection → Connection settings → Protocol type and switch to “Codex (Responses)”, then retry.
relay.storeRejected: This custom LLM rejects the store/disable_response_storage field. Open Providers → this connection → Connection settings → Compatibility and turn off “Don't keep responses in the cloud”, then retry.
relay.serviceTierRejected: This custom LLM does not accept the current OpenAI service tier value. Open Providers → this connection → Connection settings → Compatibility and clear “OpenAI service tier”, then retry.
relay.maxTokensRequired: This custom LLM requires the max_tokens parameter. Open Advanced Settings and set a max_tokens value, then retry.
relay.anthropicAuthRequired: This custom LLM expects an Anthropic-style x-api-key header. Open Providers → this connection → Connection settings → Authentication and switch to “x-api-key”, then retry.
relay.imageSchemaMismatch: Image attachments use a schema that does not match this custom LLM's protocol. Open Providers → this connection → Connection settings → Protocol type and choose a protocol that fits your model, then retry.
relay.rateLimited: This custom LLM hit a rate limit. Wait a moment, lower request volume, or switch to another key or custom LLM.
relay.imageRouteUnsupported: Image generation is not available on this protocol. Open Providers → this connection → Connection settings → Protocol and switch to OpenAI Responses or Chat Completions.
relay.missingChatDriverModel: Add a chat model to this custom LLM before using image generation.
